headline: Exchange Intake Falls To 952.8 Million Dollars From 1,232.1 Million
narrative: Clean-asset intake across 79 venues fell to 952.8 million dollars, 0.3499 percent of the 272.3 billion dollars held there excluding each venue's own token, from 1,232.1 million dollars and 0.4517 percent in the prior reading. Binance took in 610.8 million dollars and Bitget took in 581.3 million dollars, while OKX posted a 43.2 million dollar outflow and Bitfinex posted a 41.7 million dollar outflow. The pipe measures the change in dollars held on the venues excluding each exchange's own token, so the smaller positive total means less money arrived than in the prior reading, with Binance and Bitget still the largest arrivals.
author: jordan
